## Automated Tests Required

### Story 025 — Integration

**Test file path**: `tests/integration/sys_narrative/rain_stops_tail_test.py`

The test must cover:

- exact 15-unit baseline set and unchanged six ending IDs/resolver map;
- `ending_rain_stops` as the only successor to
  `epilogue_rain_stops_arcade`;
- existing lights-out scene and `event_epilogue_lights_out_completed` before
  the new tail, with no duplicate completion call/event;
- ordinary-observer and clearly marked written-note structure;
- no `erii` speech line for the written note;
- no new choice/menu, axis/token/resource/qualification/persistence/
  achievement/Gallery identifiers or asset paths;
- forbidden extra-world-state boundary and no line-for-line reuse marker;
- final `endings.rpy` and baseline hashes matching `design/content-lock.md`.

**Engine regression**:

- `uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'`
- `tools/run-renpy-tests.ps1 -Suite global -TimeoutSeconds 120`
- pinned Ren'Py `lint --compile`
- `tools/test-content-constraints.ps1`
- `git diff --check`

**Edge cases**:

- non-rain ending labels have no epilogue tail;
- tail source appears before no later label and after both existing completion
  event assignments;
- the note marker is present but no `erii "..."` line exists;
- source has no new `menu:` or choice IDs;
- content-lock hash mismatch fails the focused test rather than being ignored.
